title: Escalated conformance fixture
description: One rule, stated as inputs and the result every port must produce. Deliberately language-neutral: a fixture describes behaviour, never an implementation.

id.description: Stable identifier, `<area>/<slug>`. Runners report failures by this, so it must not change once published.

rule.description: One sentence, in the present tense, saying what must be true.

source.description: Path in escalated-developer-context this was taken from. A fixture with no canonical source is a guess.

priority.description: Only for ordered chains, where the position is itself the thing being asserted.

security.description: Set when failing this fixture is a vulnerability rather than a bug. Runners should not allow these to be skipped.

given.description: The inputs. Ports map these onto their own models.

expect.description: The observable result. Assert on these and nothing else.

notes.description: Anything a runner needs in order to build the inputs, such as a value it has to compute.

why.description: What breaks if a port gets this wrong. Written for whoever hits the failure in six months.
